name: study-brief
title: Pricing research study brief
for_each: select id,name from studies order by name

sections.title: Sample reconciliation
sections.sql: select imported,eligible,excluded,min_sample from v_sample where study_id=$1

sections.title: Segments
sections.sql: select segment,imported,eligible,excluded from v_segments where study_id=$1 order by segment

sections.title: Price perception curves
sections.note: Percentages describe unweighted eligible responses. An agreed minimum controls summary results. These curves do not forecast demand or profit.
sections.sql: select price,sample,too_cheap_pct,cheap_pct,expensive_pct,too_expensive_pct from v_curves where study_id=$1 order by price

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,closure_evidence from actions where study_id=$1 order by due_on,id

name: decision-record
title: Pricing decision record
for_each: select id,title from decisions order by created_at,id

sections.title: Decision and rationale
sections.sql: select d.title,d.proposed_price,s.currency,s.price_unit,d.rationale,d.evidence_ref,d.actor,d.review_on from decisions d join studies s on s.id=d.study_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Saved analysis at the decision date
sections.note: Frozen evidence. The proposed price is a human decision, not an automatically optimal price.
sections.sql: select x->>'metric' as measure,x->>'sample' as sample,x->>'low' as low,x->>'high' as high,x->>'status' as status from decisions d cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(d.snapshot->'results') x where d.id=$1
